requirements.title: Local port binding
requirements.detail: No role-specific port bind was recorded. Binding tests availability only. A busy port can already belong to the intended service. It does not prove firewall, NAT or ingress. DA port is release-specific: 7000 in the old devnet profile and 7001 in the prepared profile. Select --da-port only from your approved release.

source.quote: configuration uses private-network P2P TCP 30333 and host DA TCP 7000, mapped to container TCP 7000

requirements.detail: Server minus local intervals: [-865, 4105] ms; [-264, 1133] ms. Spec timing_max_clock_skew_ms = 250 ms. HTTP Date has second precision and cannot certify this bound or the miner-agent clock difference. No precise clock verdict. Check time synchronization.
